skill.name: grilling
skill.description: Stress-test plans and designs through focused questions before implementation.
skill.summary: Guides rigorous planning interviews that clarify decisions before work begins.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no findings across one prompt-only file. Manual review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection, executable code, network access, or data exfiltration intent. No security remediation is required.

content.value_statement: Unclear plans create rework and missed decisions. This skill drives a structured planning interview that surfaces assumptions before implementation.
actual_capabilities: Asks focused questions about a plan or design one at a time.
Identifies unresolved decisions and dependencies before implementation.
Recommends an answer for each question to keep planning moving.
Looks up factual details in the codebase when available.
Stops before execution until the user confirms shared understanding.
limitations: Does not implement the plan unless the user explicitly confirms readiness.
Depends on user feedback for decisions that cannot be inferred from files.
Does not replace domain review for legal, safety, or compliance decisions.
May be slower than direct implementation because it prioritizes clarification.

use_cases.title: Clarify Product Direction
use_cases.description: Expose missing requirements, tradeoffs, and dependencies before a team commits to a build.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Plans
use_cases.description: Check architecture choices, implementation order, and unresolved engineering decisions.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Implementation
use_cases.description: Turn a rough idea into a confirmed plan before starting work.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Plan Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Grill my plan for building [feature]. Ask one question at a time and recommend an answer for each question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you have a simple feature idea and want a focused planning review.

prompt_templates.title: Requirements Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Stress-test this product requirement: [requirement]. Find missing decisions, ask one question at a time, and wait after each question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before turning a requirement into tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Technical Design Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Grill this technical design before implementation: [design]. Look up codebase facts when needed, but ask me for decisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when architecture choices or implementation order need review.

prompt_templates.title: Dependency Mapping Workshop
prompt_templates.prompt: Interrogate this multi-step plan: [plan]. Walk each design branch, map decision dependencies, and stop before implementation until I confirm alignment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for complex plans with connected product and technical decisions.

output_examples.input: I want to add account switching to our app.
output_examples.output: First question: Which user role owns the account switcher decision? Recommended answer: assign ownership to the authenticated user context.

output_examples.input: Review my checkout redesign plan before I build it.
output_examples.output: First question: What outcome proves the redesign worked? Recommended answer: choose a measurable conversion or completion metric before design work.

output_examples.input: Help me stress-test a migration plan.
output_examples.output: First question: What rollback path must exist before migration starts? Recommended answer: define a tested rollback step before scheduling the change.

best_practices: Start with a specific plan, not a broad idea.
Answer each decision question before moving to the next branch.
Let the assistant inspect files for facts, but keep product decisions with the user.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to implement while decisions are still unresolved.
Skipping recommended answers without explaining the preferred alternative.
Using it as a substitute for expert review in regulated domains.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to clarify the plan before implementation starts.

faq.question: Why does it ask one question at a time?
faq.answer: One question keeps decisions focused and reduces confusion during planning.

faq.question: Can it inspect my codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It can look for factual context in files when the environment allows it.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Use it when a plan needs sharper requirements, tradeoff review, or decision sequencing.

faq.question: Can it recommend answers?
faq.answer: Yes. It should provide a recommended answer with each question to keep progress clear.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive projects?
faq.answer: It contains no executable code, but users should still avoid sharing secrets in prompts.
